name: causal_expert_prefetch_bound_v1

causality.pass_condition: maximum measured host-expert-id-ready to native expert-dispatch-ready interval is smaller than the fastest measured time to transfer one expert object

claim_boundary: This amendment tests whether arbitrary expert-storage prefetch is causally available in the pinned host-driven Qwen runtime. It does not claim a general impossibility of learned expert prediction, speculative execution, GPUDirect Storage, or another redesigned scheduler. It may only remove the all-expert-perfect-prefetch falsification sensitivity for the measured conventional host-driven runtime path when the predeclared causal gate passes.
